name: Tower Base Moment Structural Composition
description: Tower base bending moment is structurally composed from three independent contributions: mean wind thrust moment, turbulence-driven dynamic amplification, and wave loading (for offshore). Structural UPR: total CZ is Minkowski sum.

consistency_relations.upr_description: Structural UPR: total tower base moment CZ is Minkowski sum of three independent load component CZs.
